definition: 用户类指标默认以 users 为主表，关联 orders 计算消费行为指标。

metrics.name: 新增用户数
metrics.sql_template: COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE signup_date >= DATE('now', '-30 days')

metrics.name: 活跃用户数
metrics.sql_template: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE('now', '-30 days')

metrics.name: 流失用户数
metrics.sql_template: COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE('now', '-60 days'))

metrics.name: 用户留存率
metrics.sql_template: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_next_order THEN user_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)

metrics.name: LTV
metrics.sql_template: SUM(amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id 后取平均
